note: 26 hook formulas for short-form video, fused from two packs by the same author. The 21 spoken formulas and their classifier patterns come from Jakeschincariol/youtube-agent-skill; The Cost, The Time Anchor and The Walk-Away come from Jakeschincariol/linkedin-agent-skill; The Payoff and The Replacement encode Jake's own rule that a hook leads with money made, money saved or a number. Every formula carries the spoken line (example), the on-screen line (on_screen, six words or fewer), a written line for LinkedIn or a caption (written), and the way it usually fails. hookscore.py names a hook by counting matching patterns: most hits wins, and ties go to the formula listed first, which is why the specific money formulas come first and the broad ones last. The name is a judgement about the words, never a claim about why a video got its views.
rules: Lead with the payoff: money made, money saved, time saved, or a number. If you do not have a real number, ask for one. Never invent it.
The spoken line and the on-screen line are written separately. On screen is the shorter, blunter one, six words or fewer.
Confirm the promise in the first sentence. A hook that ignores its own title or cover is why people leave in the first seconds.
One idea. A hook carrying two promises keeps neither.
Specific beats big. '400 to 200,000 in seven months' outperforms 'massive growth'.
Show the artifact early if you promised one: the receipt, the screen, the result.
Never open with who you are, a greeting, or 'in this video'. The video starts at the sentence you would normally reach at second six.
If the hook works with any other creator's name on it, it is not your hook. Put the thing only you can say in it.

hooks.name: The Payoff
hooks.shape: The result as the first words: money made, money saved, or time saved, then how.
hooks.example: I saved $400 on flights last month with one prompt.
hooks.written: I saved $400 on two flights last month with one prompt. Here it is.
hooks.fails_when: A number you cannot show. Payoff hooks die on the first 'proof?' comment, so the receipt goes on screen in the next beat.

hooks.name: The Cost
hooks.shape: A specific cost, stated first, then the one mistake that caused it.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what one missing clause in a contract cost me.
hooks.written: $18,000 is what not having a contract cost me last March.
hooks.fails_when: A fake-humble mistake. 'I care too much' reads as a brag and kills it. The cost has to be real and yours.

hooks.name: The Time Anchor
hooks.shape: A task that used to take a long time, and how long it takes now.
hooks.example: Editing one reel used to take me four hours. Now it takes twenty minutes.
hooks.written: Writing a week of posts used to take me 5 hours. It now takes 20 minutes.
hooks.fails_when: An unbelievable ratio. 5 hours to 20 minutes lands. 5 hours to 8 seconds does not.

hooks.name: The Replacement
hooks.shape: Something cheap that replaced something expensive, with both prices said out loud.
hooks.example: This $20 app just replaced the editor I was paying $2,000 a month.
hooks.written: A $20 app replaced the $2,000-a-month editor I had on retainer.
hooks.fails_when: An unfair comparison. Say what the expensive option still does better, or the comments will say it for you.

hooks.name: The Walk-Away
hooks.shape: I fired, quit, deleted or cancelled something valuable, and the result with a number.
hooks.example: I fired my highest-paying client in January. Revenue is up 30% since.
hooks.written: I fired my highest-paying client in January. Revenue is up 30%.
hooks.fails_when: Walking away with no cost. Name what it actually cost you or it reads as theatre.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.shape: A named person's outcome, then the mechanism.
hooks.example: This channel went from 400 subscribers to 200,000 in seven months on one format. I mapped it.
hooks.written: One creator went from 400 subscribers to 200,000 in seven months on a single format. I mapped it.
hooks.fails_when: Do not invent the number. If you cannot name the channel, use a different formula.

hooks.name: Before and After
hooks.shape: Two states, one cut between them.
hooks.example: This was my thumbnail. This is my thumbnail now. Same video, four times the click-through.
hooks.written: 18 months ago I was writing proposals at 2am. Today I send them in 6 minutes. One template did it.
hooks.fails_when: Only works with a visual. Do not use it on a talking-head-only video.

hooks.name: I Tried It
hooks.shape: First-person experiment with a stated cost.
hooks.example: I let an AI run my channel for 30 days. I did not touch the uploads.
hooks.written: I sent 400 cold DMs in 30 days. 11 replied. 2 became clients.
hooks.fails_when: Needs a real cost: time, money or risk. Without one there is no stake.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.shape: Show the artifact first, explain second.
hooks.example: This is the analytics page. This video did 40% of the channel's watch time. Here is why.
hooks.written: $41,000 in 90 days from one offer. This is the Stripe screenshot.
hooks.fails_when: Requires a real screenshot. A described receipt is not a receipt.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.shape: Two named options, one winner.
hooks.example: I wrote the same video three ways. One of them held 62% and the other two did not.
hooks.written: A $12,000 brand agency vs a $20 tool and a weekend. The weekend won.
hooks.fails_when: Say the losing option out loud. A comparison with no loser is an advert.

hooks.name: The Teardown
hooks.shape: Take a real thing apart in public.
hooks.example: I pulled the nine most-viewed AI videos of the month and broke down what the titles share.
hooks.written: I pulled the 9 most-viewed posts in my niche this month. 7 of them open the same way.
hooks.fails_when: Name what you pulled and how many. A teardown of one example is an anecdote.

hooks.name: The Stack
hooks.shape: Two named tools combined into one outcome.
hooks.example: Claude plus your YouTube Studio export gives you next week's upload schedule in one prompt.
hooks.written: Claude plus your analytics export gives you next week's content plan in one prompt.
hooks.fails_when: Both tools must be nameable and the outcome must need both.

hooks.name: The Clock
hooks.shape: Bound the payoff in time.
hooks.example: In the next six minutes you will have a working title, thumbnail and script for your next video.
hooks.written: Give this 4 minutes and you will leave with next week's posts planned.
hooks.fails_when: The clock has to be true. Overrun it and the next video's hook is not believed.

hooks.name: The List
hooks.shape: A counted set, with the count in the first line.
hooks.example: Seven things I would do differently if I started a channel in 2026.
hooks.written: 7 things I wish someone had told me before I hired my first employee.
hooks.fails_when: The count must be exact and every item must be different in kind.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.shape: A number the viewer did not know, stated flat, then the consequence.
hooks.example: 97% of the people who start a channel quit before video 30. Here is what the other 3% do differently.
hooks.written: 97% of people who start a channel quit before video 30. The other 3% do one thing differently.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the number is vague or unverifiable. Say the source out loud.

hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.shape: Name the error the viewer is probably making right now.
hooks.example: Your first 30 seconds are why nobody finishes your videos. It is not the topic.
hooks.written: If you are still writing your LinkedIn posts in the LinkedIn composer, stop.
hooks.fails_when: Only works if the mistake is common and the viewer can check it in one second.

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.shape: State the accepted advice, then reject it.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted once a week for a year and tripled the channel.
hooks.written: Everyone says post daily. I posted 4x a week for a year and beat every daily poster in my niche.
hooks.fails_when: Needs evidence in the next 15 seconds or it reads as contrarian for its own sake.

hooks.name: The Insider
hooks.shape: Information from inside a system.
hooks.example: YouTube tells you which videos are underperforming. Almost nobody opens the report.
hooks.written: After 9 years in agency sales, here is the part nobody puts in the job posting.
hooks.fails_when: Do not claim insider access you do not have.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.shape: A cost the viewer is about to pay.
hooks.example: Do not upload another video until you check this one setting.
hooks.written: Your 'quick call to align' is quietly costing you six hours a week.
hooks.fails_when: If the cost is small the hook is a lie. Reserve it.

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.shape: Something is changing on a date.
hooks.example: The old description format stops mattering this month. Here is what replaces it.
hooks.written: Your old hashtag strategy stopped working on 18 December 2025, when Instagram capped every post at five.
hooks.fails_when: Only use with a real, checkable date. This is the fastest formula to lose trust with.

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.shape: Promise a specific thing will be shown, then show it.
hooks.example: I am going to show you the exact prompt, on screen, that wrote this video.
hooks.written: Here is the exact 4-line email I used to reopen 3 dead deals. Steal it.
hooks.fails_when: You have to actually show it, early. A reveal at 8:00 is a retention cliff at 1:00.

hooks.name: The Origin
hooks.shape: Where a result actually came from.
hooks.example: Every video on this channel starts in the same 12-line file. Here it is.
hooks.written: Every post I write starts in the same 12-line file. Here it is.
hooks.fails_when: Works once per channel. It is a reveal about you, and you only have one.

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.shape: The single best, worst or fastest of a category.
hooks.example: This is the fastest way to turn one long video into thirty Shorts.
hooks.written: The best hire I ever made failed the interview.
hooks.fails_when: Superlatives are cheap. Earn it by naming what it beat.

hooks.name: The Direct Address
hooks.shape: Name the exact viewer in the first six words.
hooks.example: If you have under a thousand subscribers, this is the only video you need this week.
hooks.written: If you run an agency with under 10 people, this is the only hiring advice you need this year.
hooks.fails_when: Narrow beats broad. 'If you make videos' addresses nobody.

hooks.name: The Impossible Claim
hooks.shape: State something that sounds untrue, then prove it.
hooks.example: You can write, title, thumbnail and schedule a week of videos without opening a single editor.
hooks.written: You can book 14 sales calls a month without sending a single cold message.
hooks.fails_when: The proof has to start within 20 seconds or it reads as clickbait.

hooks.name: The Question
hooks.shape: Ask the exact question the viewer typed into search.
hooks.example: Why do your videos die at 30 seconds when the topic is fine?
hooks.written: Your best client asks for a 40% discount and hints they will leave without it. What do you do?
hooks.fails_when: Must be the viewer's question, not yours. Pull it from your own comments.
